rows.notes: [T063 2026-11-22] NEW (Japan sweep). LEJ's main cell plant at Ritto, Shiga (a separate site from the Kusatsu row; the removed Sekisui Ritto row is unrelated). REPORTED tier only: the MONOist 2011-12-14 page text was garbled when fetched. It describes Ritto phase 1 as about 800 MWh with shipments planned from April 2012 (plan, not confirmed start) and a later expansion to about 2.3 GWh by winter 2013. The 2.3 GWh looks like the LEJ-wide total (three plants were then about 1,090 MWh combined, Kusatsu about 110 MWh, Kyoto about 180 MWh) rather than Ritto alone, so it is NOT used as nameplate; nameplate 0.8 = Ritto phase 1 only, ref_year 2012 = the planned phase-1 shipment year. Site total is therefore likely higher. Status left null: no source in hand says Ritto is producing today (13-year-old plan text only); LEJ is understood to still run it but this is not evidenced. No current capacity found. Coordinates not located -> null. Lead: fetch a current GS Yuasa integrated report for LEJ Ritto capacity.
